title: VoxelCore block material
description: Block material (<pack>/block_materials/<name>.json, id pack:name), read by BlockMaterial::deserialize (src/voxels/Block.cpp). Referenced from a block's material.
markdownDescription: Block material (`<pack>/block_materials/<name>.json`, id `pack:name`), read by `BlockMaterial::deserialize` (`src/voxels/Block.cpp`). Referenced from a block's `material`.

name.markdownDescription: Overrides the material name. Normally omitted: the id is `pack:<file name>`.
name.description: Overrides the material name. Normally omitted: the id is pack:<file name>.

steps-sound.markdownDescription: Footsteps sound name (e.g. `steps/stone`), loaded with all its variants.
steps-sound.description: Footsteps sound name (e.g. steps/stone), loaded with all its variants.

place-sound.markdownDescription: Sound played when a block of this material is placed.
place-sound.description: Sound played when a block of this material is placed.

break-sound.markdownDescription: Sound played when a block of this material is broken.
break-sound.description: Sound played when a block of this material is broken.

hit-sound.markdownDescription: Sound played while hitting the block. Default: `steps-sound`.
hit-sound.description: Sound played while hitting the block. Default: steps-sound.

sound-absorption.markdownDescription:
How much the material absorbs sound (used by audio occlusion), 0.0 to 1.0.

Default: `0.5`.
sound-absorption.description:
How much the material absorbs sound (used by audio occlusion), 0.0 to 1.0.

Default: 0.5.
